text: The app is just as good as the social media hype says. I didn't typically use transcription, considering it inaccurate, however this app has completely changed my perception about it. I only had to add a comma and one word in two long paragraphs. Its speed is also one to be reckoned with for heavy AI-based apps of its kind. It even captures names of localities and can write units with symbols (eg. if I say "kilowatt-hours" the app will automatically convert it to "kWh").
